comparison.objective: Clear a fragile egg from a trivet before placing a pot on it.
comparison.physical_skill: Obstruction inspection, fragile-object relocation, and safe placement of a heavier object.
comparison.success_condition: Egg safely supported elsewhere and pot upright on the trivet, with no damaging pot–egg contact.
comparison.reason: The tested ability is safe obstruction removal and placement; it lacks a continuous guide interface, sliding carriage, or contained free elements.
